A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same SL-S4Wave study, including complete Appendices A–H. All 34 pages are readable. Pages 2–34 have identical extracted text and rendered appearance; first-page differences concern an author name and the arXiv stamp.

before.justification: v1 reports original arrhythmia-classification experiments, component ablations, and EEG evaluations, including Tables 1–3 and Appendix F, Table 18.

after.justification: v2 retains the same original arrhythmia and EEG experiments, ablations, and supplementary empirical analyses.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the identical S4Wave encoder, global convolutions, gating, noise-resilient and context-consistency losses, and fine-tuning procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use VTaC, MIMIC II and Challenge 2015 for arrhythmia experiments, plus TUH EEG pretraining and SEED-V, Mental Arithmetic and ISRUC_S3 evaluation. Task and test-scenario coverage is unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in corresponding main-text and appendix experiments. This includes ECG-JEPA and ECGFounder in Table 1, encoder comparisons in Tables 3 and 6, and BENDR, BIOT, LaBraM and EEGPT in Table 18.

E3.justification: The evaluation metrics, dataset splits, preprocessing, input durations, model configurations and training budgets are unchanged throughout Section 4 and the appendices.

E4.justification: The loss and architecture ablations, label-efficiency analysis, sequence-length comparisons, block-count and kernel-size sensitivity studies, efficiency analysis, and waveform examples are all retained without changes.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same run counts, seed descriptions, means, standard deviations and plotted uncertainty. Table 1 still specifies five runs except for the deterministic rule-based method; Appendix F retains five-experiment reporting.

E6.justification: All numerical entries, plotted results and qualitative findings are identical. For example, Table 1 retains SL-S4Wave's VTaC AUC of 96.01 ± 0.29, and Table 18 retains Mental Arithmetic balanced accuracy of 88.52 ± 1.22.

T1.justification: All equations and mathematical reasoning are unchanged, including the state-space derivations in Appendix A and kernel definitions in Appendix C. No assumptions, propositions or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain identical claims about the encoder, contrastive framework, long-sequence modeling, label efficiency and generalization across arrhythmia and EEG tasks.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations and interpretations are identical. Existing qualifications concerning sparse-data instability, possible overfitting and computational constraints in Appendix B are unchanged.

D1.justification: Implementation hyperparameters, hardware, preprocessing and filtering instructions, and reported code, pretrained-weight and dataset access information are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, the reference list and research positioning throughout the paper are identical. No cited work or claimed relationship to prior research changes.

P1.justification: The first-page author name changes from 'Rahul Krishnan' to 'Rahul G. Krishnan', and the arXiv version/date text is updated. Body prose, terminology, section order and appendix organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: The first-page arXiv margin stamp is updated and repositioned. Figures 1–9, Tables 1–18, their captions and all remaining page layouts are identical.

improvement.justification: v2 adds an author's middle initial and updates the arXiv stamp. The scientific text, evidence, mathematical content, reproducibility information and appendices are otherwise identical, establishing no meaningful overall quality difference.
